long_biography.plain_text:
Biomedica Foscama's distressed Ferentino plant brought a halted pharmaceutical operation under Massimiliano Florio's direction. The Italian executive chaired both the acquired business and its parent, Special Product's Line. After an overhaul of a site whose regulatory permissions had been suspended, medicine production resumed and the company began supplying overseas markets.

At Ferentino, Florio also directed a vaccine fill-and-finish project, covering the stages between vaccine production and distribution. The Italian government and Lazio region provided development support for the facility alongside company investment. Florio has represented pharmaceutical employers in Lazio and was elected a vice-president of Farmindustria.
